lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are organized into approximately five distinct horizontal rows along the lateral flank. The spatial arrangement exhibits a grid-like distribution with roughly equidistant spacing between local maxima in the mid-body section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form rectangular anchor points, particularly evident in the mid-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary linear ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank; each ridge displays a high-contrast luminance gradient with light-colored reflectance on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or loss of tissue is visible on the posterior (trailing) edge of the first dorsal fin, located approximately midway between the apex and the base.
